newsitem.title: ISRAEL: SOCCER-HAPOEL BEERSHEBA WIN ISRAELI STATE CUP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-HAPOEL BEERSHEBA WIN ISRAELI STATE CUP.

text.p: Hapoel Beersheba won the Israeli State Cup for the first time in their history with a 1-0 win over defending champions Maccabi Tel Aviv in the final on Monday.
Croatian midfielder Giovanni Rosso scored the only goal of the game in the 40th minute with a scissor kick.
Beersheba will represent Israel in next season's European Cup Winners' Cup while Maccabi Tel Aviv, the outgoing league champions, reflect on one of their worst seasons in recent years.

Maccabi Tel Aviv will not represent Israel in any UEFA competition for the first time since clubs from the Jewish State began playing in Europe in 1993. The rich Tel Aviv club is destined for a mid-table finish when the league ends next weekend.
Beersheba's win determined that Hapoel Petah Tikva will play in the UEFA Cup, while newly-crowned champions Betar Jerusalem will represent Israel in the Champions' League.
